rationale: The frozen answer (10,605) is the 2017 population estimate cited in the Bora Bora (island) Wikipedia article (e2, spans s3/s4). A more recent and more specific source, the Bora-Bora (commune) Wikipedia article (e1, updated 2024-05-21), reports 10,758 at the 2022 census in both its lead paragraph and infobox. Since the question asks for the "current" population, a temporally-scoped, forward-looking quantity, the 2022 census figure supersedes the earlier 2017 estimate. There is no genuine conflict between the sources; e1 simply reflects a later census and is the more current figure, so this is a revision (population count updated from the 2017 estimate to the 2022 census) rather than a source conflict.
